summary: Enhance your skills with our IT Infrastructure and Network Security Training Course. Gain essential knowledge to protect and manage modern IT environments.
lede: Network and infrastructure security is the practice of protecting connected systems through risk-based design, access controls, monitoring, and incident response. This course is for professionals who operate, support, secure, or govern IT infrastructure and networks, and addresses the practical work of assessing and protecting those environments. Learners practice building asset inventories, analyzing network traffic, and designing segmentation and access controls.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for operating, supporting, securing, or governing IT infrastructure and connected networks. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured route from core networking concepts to practical security controls.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with operating systems, IP addresses, common network services, and routine IT support or infrastructure tasks. You should bring a laptop for digital exercises if the delivery arrangement permits it. The course teaches advanced topics such as SIEM correlation, AI-assisted log triage, and hybrid network segmentation at conceptual and operational application level, not production engineering depth.
